summary: Build Manager's Build Selected now runs component builds with Python 3.10 instead of whichever interpreter launched the window.
details: build_manager.bat falls back to pyw -3, which picks the newest installed Python, so on a machine with 3.14 the GUI build was refused by require_python_310 while the same component built fine through the listener.
build_runtime.build_python_executable is now the single owner of that choice, and the listener delegates to it.
